children: Rotork plc, the market-leading global provider of mission-critical intelligent flow control solutions, announces that Kiet Huynh has been appointed as an independent Non-Executive Director of Severn Trent Plc with effect from 1 October 2026.
Stuart Pain, Group General Counsel & Company Secretary
